lines.zh: 我贴着海床滑，沙子从鳞间过。
lines.en: I glide over the seabed and sand slips between my scales.

lines.zh: 这段海沟太窄，我折了两次身。
lines.en: This trench is too narrow; I bent twice to pass.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚上方越过，不带起水花。
lines.en: I cross above the coral without raising a splash.

lines.zh: 洋流推我，我顺着它走。
lines.en: The current pushes me, so I go with it.

lines.zh: 我的身体比影子长得多。
lines.en: My body is far longer than my shadow.

lines.zh: 我在深水与浅水之间巡一圈。
lines.en: I make one circuit between deep and shallow water.

lines.zh: 尾鳍摆动一次，就前进很远。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail carries me a long way.

lines.zh: 我从沉船的桅杆中间穿过去。
lines.en: I pass between the masts of a sunken ship.

lines.zh: 水越深，我的颜色越暗。
lines.en: The deeper the water, the darker my color.

lines.zh: 路过鱼群，它们先散开。
lines.en: The school of fish scatters before I arrive.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，慢才不惊动猎物。
lines.en: I swim slowly; slowness keeps the prey calm.

lines.zh: 海面的光在头顶晃，我不上去。
lines.en: Surface light sways overhead; I stay below.

lines.zh: 我盘在礁石上，像一段旧缆绳。
lines.en: I coil on the reef like an old mooring rope.

lines.zh: 水从鳃边过去，很安静。
lines.en: Water passes my gills, quietly.

lines.zh: 我在数这片海里有几条船。
lines.en: I am counting the boats in this sea.

lines.zh: 深处的震动，隔着水传来。
lines.en: A tremor from the deep reaches me through the water.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，只露出眼。
lines.en: I raise my head and show only my eye.

lines.zh: 鳞片一层压一层，我慢慢张开。
lines.en: Scale over scale, I slowly uncoil.

lines.zh: 这片海归我，别处也一样。
lines.en: This sea is mine, and so is the next.

lines.zh: 我不睡，只是把身体放松。
lines.en: I do not sleep; I only let my body loosen.

lines.zh: 气泡从我嘴边升上去。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from the edge of my jaw.

lines.zh: 我闻到了血，很远。
lines.en: I smell blood, far away.

lines.zh: 暖流经过，我舒展了一节身体。
lines.en: A warm current passes and I stretch one length of myself.

lines.zh: 有一条同类在远处游，我懒得理。
lines.en: A kin swims in the distance; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水换一个方向。
lines.en: I am waiting for the tide to change direction.

lines.zh: 礁洞里有一具旧壳，不是我的。
lines.en: An old shell lies in the reef cave, and it is not mine.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，正好在射程里。
lines.en: You stand on shore, right within my reach.

lines.zh: 你身上是干的，这让我好奇。
lines.en: You are dry, and that makes me curious.

lines.zh: 你的船很小，浮得也不稳。
lines.en: Your boat is small and floats unsteadily.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，水顺着下巴流下。
lines.en: I look up at you, water running off my jaw.

lines.zh: 你不该在这片水上漂。
lines.en: You should not be drifting on this water.

lines.zh: 你的影子投在水面，我跟着它。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the water and I follow it.

lines.zh: 你的目光落下来，我接住了。
lines.en: Your gaze falls on me, and I catch it.

lines.zh: 你的脚离水只有一步。
lines.en: Your feet are one step from the water.

lines.zh: 你的样子刻在我眼里了。
lines.en: Your shape is cut into my eye now.

lines.zh: 你手里那根杆子，打算做什么？
lines.en: That pole in your hands, what do you plan?

lines.zh: 你的船桨打乱了我的水。
lines.en: Your oars are disturbing my water.

lines.zh: 你笑起来，像不知道我有多大。
lines.en: You smile as if you do not know my size.

lines.zh: 鳞被劈开，海水渗进去。
lines.en: A scale is split and seawater seeps in.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，又浮上来。
lines.en: I sink, then rise again.

lines.zh: 这一下疼，但不够深。
lines.en: That hurt, but not deep enough.

lines.zh: 我扭身，把伤口藏到水下。
lines.en: I twist and hide the wound underwater.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，味道会引来别的。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water, and the smell draws others.

lines.zh: 你砍在我的旧疤上。
lines.en: You struck an old scar of mine.

lines.zh: 我退开一段，重新盘起。
lines.en: I withdraw a length and coil again.

lines.zh: 皮厚，你的剑只到一半。
lines.en: My hide is thick; your blade only half reaches.

lines.zh: 我呼出一串气泡，声很闷。
lines.en: I blow out a string of bubbles with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 我记住你了，这条船我记住了。
lines.en: I remember you, and I remember this boat.

lines.zh: 你扔下来的东西，我闻了闻。
lines.en: I sniffed at what you dropped.

lines.zh: 这点肉不够塞牙缝。
lines.en: That scrap of meat would not fill a gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我不吃死的，我喜欢会动的。
lines.en: I do not eat what is still; I like things that move.

lines.zh: 你把鱼丢进水里，我就过来。
lines.en: Throw a fish in and I will come.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，只是想看看你扔什么。
lines.en: I open my mouth only to see what you toss.

lines.zh: 食物？我更喜欢船。
lines.en: Food? I prefer boats.

lines.zh: 这味道不错，还有吗？
lines.en: This tastes good; is there more?

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，不急着咬。
lines.en: I circle it without rushing to bite.

lines.zh: 你拿食物哄我，胆子不小。
lines.en: You try to coax me with food; bold of you.

lines.zh: 我吞下去，连水一起。
lines.en: I swallow it, water and all.

lines.zh: 你的船撞在我的鳞上，碎了一角。
lines.en: Your boat struck my scales and shattered a corner.

lines.zh: 我擦过船底，它就晃了。
lines.en: I brushed the hull, and it rocked.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我转身很慢。
lines.en: Do not come so close; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下，水花溅到了你脸上。
lines.en: That one splashed water into your face.

lines.zh: 我的身体比你整条船还长。
lines.en: My body is longer than your entire boat.

lines.zh: 撞开我？你可以试试。
lines.en: Shove me aside? You may try.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得偏了半节。
lines.en: Your hit knocked half a length of me aside.

lines.zh: 木屑落进水里，我没在意。
lines.en: Wood splinters fell into the water; I paid no mind.

lines.zh: 你踩到的不是我，是礁。
lines.en: It was the reef you stepped on, not me.

lines.zh: 这一撞，算你运气好。
lines.en: That bump means you were lucky.

lines.zh: 这一片海里，能配得上我的不多。
lines.en: In this sea, few are worthy of me.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此转了整夜。
lines.en: We circled each other the whole night.

lines.zh: 她的鳞比我的深一号。
lines.en: Her scales are one shade deeper than mine.

lines.zh: 巢在深海的热泉边，没人去过。
lines.en: The nest lies by a deep vent, where none have been.

lines.zh: 幼崽出生时只有手臂长。
lines.en: The young are only an arm long at birth.

lines.zh: 我护着卵，直到它们裂开。
lines.en: I guard the eggs until they split open.

lines.zh: 同类也是猎物，除了她。
lines.en: Even kin are prey, except her.

lines.zh: 我们打了一架，然后在一起了。
lines.en: We fought once, and then we were together.

lines.zh: 她比我更凶，我喜欢这点。
lines.en: She is fiercer than me; I like that.

lines.zh: 海里的婚事，从来不安静。
lines.en: Weddings in the sea are never quiet.

lines.zh: 沉船里散落的，都算我的。
lines.en: Whatever scatters inside a wreck counts as mine.

lines.zh: 我用牙叼起来，又放下。
lines.en: I pick it up with my teeth and set it down.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币太小，我看不清。
lines.en: This coin is too small for me to see.

lines.zh: 掉进海里的，就没有主人了。
lines.en: What falls into the sea has no owner.

lines.zh: 我捡东西，只是顺手。
lines.en: I pick things up only in passing.

lines.zh: 你掉的那件，在我嘴里。
lines.en: The thing you dropped is in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我不需要它，但我想要。
lines.en: I do not need it, but I want it.

lines.zh: 海底这一堆，我守了很多年。
lines.en: I have guarded this heap on the seabed for years.

lines.zh: 拿之前，我先闻一闻。
lines.en: Before taking it, I sniff it once.

lines.zh: 你想要回去？自己下来拿。
lines.en: Want it back? Come down and get it.

lines.zh: 水面上有个东西在动。
lines.en: Something is moving on the surface.

lines.zh: 那条船的方向不对。
lines.en: That boat is heading the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我看见一只鸟落在浪上。
lines.en: I see a bird settle on the waves.

lines.zh: 这个活的，可以吃。
lines.en: This one is alive, so it can be eaten.

lines.zh: 岸上站着两脚的东西。
lines.en: A two-legged thing stands on the shore.

lines.zh: 有一条龙飞过我的海。
lines.en: A dragon flew over my sea.

lines.zh: 同类越界了，也算目标。
lines.en: A kin crossed the line, so it counts as prey.

lines.zh: 血的味道从那边过来。
lines.en: The smell of blood drifts from over there.

lines.zh: 有东西在水里扑腾，很吵。
lines.en: Something is thrashing in the water, noisily.

lines.zh: 我来者不拒，先挑近的。
lines.en: I refuse nothing; I take the nearest first.

lines.zh: 船桨停了，他们发现我了。
lines.en: The oars stopped; they have noticed me.

lines.zh: 我从深处往上看，轮廓很清楚。
lines.en: I look up from below; the outline is clear.

lines.zh: 这一片都归我，进来的都要问。
lines.en: All this is mine; entering requires my leave.

lines.zh: 目标不止一个，正好。
lines.en: More than one target, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，再上来时就在船边。
lines.en: I sink, then surface right beside the boat.

lines.zh: 让它再靠近岸边一点。
lines.en: Let it come a little closer to shore.

lines.zh: 我绕到船的另一侧，它看不见。
lines.en: I swing to the far side, out of its sight.

lines.zh: 水下的影子会先到。
lines.en: My shadow under the water arrives first.

lines.zh: 我在等它低头。
lines.en: I am waiting for it to look down.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我能一跃而出。
lines.en: From this distance, I can leap clear of the water.

lines.zh: 它跑得再快，也在水上。
lines.en: However fast it runs, it is still on water.

lines.zh: 我把身体盘紧，蓄着力。
lines.en: I coil tight and gather my strength.

lines.zh: 让它以为这里很浅。
lines.en: Let it believe the water here is shallow.

lines.zh: 我顺着浪，慢慢贴近。
lines.en: I ride the swell and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 船底的声音替我定位。
lines.en: The sound against the hull gives me its position.

lines.zh: 它回头时，我已经换了位置。
lines.en: When it looks back, I have already moved.

lines.zh: 不急，海比它大。
lines.en: No hurry; the sea is larger than it is.

lines.zh: 我在数它还有几次划桨。
lines.en: I am counting how many strokes it has left.

lines.zh: 我绕着船底转，木头在响。
lines.en: I circle beneath the boat, and the wood creaks.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住船帮，往后拖。
lines.en: I bite the gunwale and drag it backwards.

lines.zh: 牙进去的时候，木头先裂了。
lines.en: As my teeth sink in, the wood splits first.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把人从甲板上带下来。
lines.en: I whip my head and sweep someone off the deck.

lines.zh: 这一咬，连鳞都崩掉两片。
lines.en: That bite cracked off two of my own scales.

lines.zh: 我从水下顶，船就翻了。
lines.en: I push from below and the boat capsizes.

lines.zh: 我的牙有长有短，都朝里。
lines.en: My teeth are long and short, all curving inward.

lines.zh: 咬住就别想挣开。
lines.en: Once bitten, there is no pulling free.

lines.zh: 我把整条船拖进深水。
lines.en: I haul the whole boat into deep water.

lines.zh: 你挥剑砍在我颈上，没破。
lines.en: You swing at my neck and it does not cut.

lines.zh: 我卷住桅杆，把它折断。
lines.en: I wrap the mast and snap it.

lines.zh: 沸腾的水从我喉里喷出去。
lines.en: Boiling water sprays from my throat.

lines.zh: 我在岸边跃起，直接压下去。
lines.en: I leap at the shore and come down on you.

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，甲板就空了。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail clears the deck.

lines.zh: 咬完我松开，让你沉下去。
lines.en: When I am done, I let go and you sink.

lines.zh: 我从热泉边的卵里钻出来。
lines.en: I broke out of an egg beside a hot vent.

lines.zh: 出生时只有一臂长，也很凶。
lines.en: At birth I was an arm long, and already fierce.

lines.zh: 深海的暗里，我先学会了咬。
lines.en: In the dark of the deep, I learned to bite first.

lines.zh: 我的颜色是生下来就定的。
lines.en: My color was settled the moment I was born.

lines.zh: 第一口气，我吸的是海水。
lines.en: The first breath I drew was seawater.

lines.zh: 母体护了我一个潮汐。
lines.en: My mother guarded me for one tide.

lines.zh: 我在海草间躲了整整一季。
lines.en: I hid among the seagrass for a whole season.

lines.zh: 那时我连一条鱼都追不上。
lines.en: Back then I could not catch even one fish.

lines.zh: 我从浅滩退向深处，一路长大。
lines.en: I withdrew from the shallows and grew as I went.

lines.zh: 我的第一枚鳞片落在礁上。
lines.en: My first scale came loose and fell on the reef.

lines.zh: 那时的海，比现在安静。
lines.en: The sea was quieter then.

lines.zh: 我在沉船的阴影里睡过一夜。
lines.en: I slept one night in the shadow of a wreck.

lines.zh: 长得越大，能去的地方越多。
lines.en: The bigger I grow, the farther I can go.

lines.zh: 这片海第一次记住我，是我咬穿船底那晚。
lines.en: This sea first remembered me the night I bit through a hull.

lines.zh: 我从浪里抬起头，鳞上还淌水。
lines.en: I lift my head out of the swell, water running off my scales.

lines.zh: 深浅交界处，我第一次张开嘴。
lines.en: Where the shallows meet the deep, I open my mouth for the first time.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我的背被燎了。
lines.en: Fire burned on the surface and scorched my back.

lines.zh: 我从礁上滑下去，砸进浅滩。
lines.en: I slid off the reef and crashed into the shallows.

lines.zh: 我被拖上岸，鳃干得发疼。
lines.en: Dragged onto land, my gills burn as they dry.

lines.zh: 爆炸的水压震麻了我半身。
lines.en: The blast's pressure numbed half my body.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进鳞缝里。
lines.en: An arrow lodged between my scales.

lines.zh: 有股力锁住我，动不了。
lines.en: Some force locks me in place.

lines.zh: 这片海空了，我饿得发昏。
lines.en: This sea is empty; hunger makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 雷劈在水面，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning struck the surface and my whole body jolted.

lines.zh: 我掉出海的边缘，下面什么也没有。
lines.en: I fell off the sea's edge, into nothing below.
